about.title: About Market Flow
about.subtitle: Your trusted product discovery platform

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section_1_text: Market Flow does not collect personal information from visitors. We do not require registration, login, or any personal data to browse our website.
privacy.section_2_text: We use local storage to remember your language preference and improve your browsing experience. No tracking cookies are used.
privacy.section_3_text: Our website contains links to Shopee. When you click on these links, you will be redirected to Shopee's website. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of Shopee.
privacy.section_4_text: We collect anonymous usage statistics (page views, clicks) to improve our website. This data cannot be used to identify individual users.
privacy.section_5_text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through our Contact page.
privacy.section_1_item_2: Language preference stored in your browser

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section_1_text: Market Flow is a product discovery platform. We curate and display products from Shopee. We do not sell products directly.
terms.section_2_text: All purchases are made through Shopee. When you click 'Buy Now', you will be redirected to Shopee's website to complete your purchase. We are not responsible for any transactions made on Shopee.
terms.section_3_text: We strive to provide accurate product information, but we cannot guarantee that all information is complete or current. Prices and availability are subject to change on Shopee.
terms.section_4_text: All content on this website, including text, graphics, and logos, is the property of Market Flow unless otherwise stated.
terms.section_5_text: Market Flow is not liable for any damages arising from the use of this website or purchases made on Shopee.
terms.section_6_text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the website constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.
terms.section_4_footer: All of the above are the responsibility of the seller and Shopee.
